description: Build the shadcn CLI command that installs one or more ndekoui items, for npm, pnpm, yarn or bun. Returns the command with full registry URLs, which works in any shadcn project, and the shorter @ndeko form for projects whose components.json declares the namespace.

items.description: Registry name of an item, such as button, accordion-01 or heroes-02

name: get_install_command
title: Get install command
